docs: wSOL token mint

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: System program. The deposit SOL accounts slice follows.

accounts.name: user

accounts.name: srcTokenFrom
docs: The token account to swap src tokens from

accounts.name: destTokenTo
docs: The token account to receive dest tokens to

accounts.name: bridgeStake
docs: The bridge stake account thats withdrawn then deposited. PDA. seeds = ['bridge_stake', user.pubkey, SwapArgs.bridge_stake_seed]. Might be long-lived, make sure the seed is not already in use

accounts.name: destTokenFeeTokenAccount
docs: The dest_token_mint token account collecting fees. PDA. Seeds = ['fee', dest_token_mint.pubkey]

accounts.name: srcTokenMint
docs: Input token mint. If this is wrapped SOL, the account can be set to read-only

accounts.name: destTokenMint
docs: Output token mint. If this is wrapped SOL, the account can be set to read-only. The withdraw stake and deposit stake accounts slices follow.

The accounts of the stake pool (or Lido) that the stake account is withdrawn from, then those of the stake pool (or Marinade, or the Sanctum reserve for wrapped SOL) it is deposited into, each starting with its program; they vary by pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.user} swaps ${data.args.amount} of ${accounts.srcTokenMint} from ${accounts.srcTokenFrom} for ${accounts.destTokenMint} to ${accounts.destTokenTo}, by way of a stake account

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.
